newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Brady swap frees $605.46 mln of collateral.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Brady swap frees $605.46 mln of collateral.

text.p: Brazil's Brady bond buyback and swap offer freed $605.46 million of collateral backing the restructured debt instruments, the Central Bank said in a statement.
The bank said $118.92 million in collateral backing principal on par bonds and $41.3 million backing interest obligations on those bonds was freed.
It added that $283.64 million backing principal payments on discount bonds and $161.6 million backing interest payments on those bonds was freed.
The collateral was in the form of U.S. Treasury securities.
